sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python
# file: 06_embeddings_generation.py
# pip install openai groq numpy python-dotenv

from openai import OpenAI
import numpy as np
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os
import json

load_dotenv()

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

print("=" * 60)
print("  EMBEDDINGS GENERATION EXAMPLES")
print("=" * 60)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE 1: Generate a Single Embedding
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

text = "Artificial Intelligence is the future of technology"

response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="text-embedding-3-small",  # OpenAI embedding model
    input=text,
    encoding_format="float"          # Return as float array
)

embedding = response.data[0].embedding

print(f"\n📝 Input text: '{text}'")
print(f"\n📊 Embedding Info:")
print(f"   Dimensions:   {len(embedding)}")  # 1536 for ada-002, 1536/3072 for v3
print(f"   First 5 values: {embedding[:5]}")
print(f"   Last  5 values: {embedding[-5:]}")
print(f"   Min value: {min(embedding):.6f}")
print(f"   Max value: {max(embedding):.6f}")
print(f"   Tokens used: {response.usage.total_tokens}")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE 2: Batch Embeddings (Multiple texts at once)
# More efficient than one-by-one!
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

print("\n" + "─" * 60)
print("BATCH EMBEDDINGS:")
print("─" * 60)

texts = [
    "I love pizza",
    "Pizza is my favourite food",
    "I enjoy eating pasta",
    "Machine learning is fascinating",
    "Deep learning is a subset of machine learning",
    "I hate bad weather",
    "The stock market went up today",
    "Python is a great programming language",
]

response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="text-embedding-3-small",
    input=texts,   # Send all at once!
)

# Extract embeddings into a numpy array
embeddings = np.array([item.embedding for item in response.data])

print(f"✅ Generated {len(embeddings)} embeddings")
print(f"   Shape: {embeddings.shape}")  # (8, 1536)
print(f"   Tokens used: {response.usage.total_tokens}")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE 3: OpenAI Embedding Models Comparison
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

models_info = {
    "text-embedding-3-small": {"dims": 1536, "price_per_1M": 0.02},
    "text-embedding-3-large": {"dims": 3072, "price_per_1M": 0.13},
    "text-embedding-ada-002":  {"dims": 1536, "price_per_1M": 0.10},
}

print("\n" + "─" * 60)
print("EMBEDDING MODELS COMPARISON:")
print("─" * 60)
print(f"{'Model':<30} {'Dimensions':>12} {'Price/1M tok':>14}")
print("─" * 60)
for model, info in models_info.items():
    print(f"{model:<30} {info['dims']:>12} ${info['price_per_1M']:>13.2f}")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLE 4: Visualize What Embeddings Capture
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

print("\n" + "─" * 60)
print("WHAT EMBEDDINGS CAPTURE (semantic similarity):")
print("─" * 60)

# These pairs should have HIGH similarity (same meaning)
similar_pairs = [
    ("I love pizza", "Pizza is my favourite food"),
    ("Machine learning is fascinating", "Deep learning is a subset of machine learning"),
]

# These pairs should have LOW similarity (different meaning)
different_pairs = [
    ("I love pizza", "The stock market went up today"),
    ("Machine learning is fascinating", "I hate bad weather"),
]

def get_embedding(text):
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=text)
    return np.array(resp.data[0].embedding)

def cosine_similarity(vec1, vec2):
    return np.dot(vec1, vec2) / (np.linalg.norm(vec1) * np.linalg.norm(vec2))

print("\n✅ SIMILAR meaning pairs (should score HIGH ~0.7-1.0):")
for text1, text2 in similar_pairs:
    emb1 = get_embedding(text1)
    emb2 = get_embedding(text2)
    sim  = cosine_similarity(emb1, emb2)
    print(f"   '{text1[:30]}...' vs '{text2[:30]}...'")
    print(f"   Similarity: {sim:.4f} {'✅ HIGH' if sim > 0.7 else '⚠️ LOW'}\n")

print("❌ DIFFERENT meaning pairs (should score LOW ~0.0-0.5):")
for text1, text2 in different_pairs:
    emb1 = get_embedding(text1)
    emb2 = get_embedding(text2)
    sim  = cosine_similarity(emb1, emb2)
    print(f"   '{text1[:30]}' vs '{text2[:30]}'")
    print(f"   Similarity: {sim:.4f} {'✅ LOW' if sim < 0.5 else '⚠️ HIGH'}\n")
```
